generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The method `match(Object value, String pattern, Boolean caseInsensitive)` calls `Pattern.compile(pattern, flags)` on every invocation. While this may be acceptable if only used during constant folding (which typically occurs once per query plan), it is a significant performance bottleneck if this utility is ever utilized in a runtime evaluation context. Consider caching compiled patterns or encouraging the use of the `Pattern` overload.

The implementation of `BinaryLogicOperation` is inconsistent with `BinaryComparisonOperation` regarding the use of the `PredicateBiFunction` interface. While `BinaryComparisonOperation` uses `apply()` as a wrapper for null-handling and delegates the core logic to `doApply()`, `BinaryLogicOperation` places all logic within `apply()` (via a private field) and leaves `doApply()` returning `null`. This breaks the architectural pattern established in the same module.
